t253.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Ibrāhīm ibn al-Mundhir ibn ʿAbd Allāh al-Asadī al-Ḥizāmī as truthful, of the tenth generation. Aḥmad criticized him regarding the Qur'an. He died in the year 36.
as: Aḥmad criticized him regarding the Qur'an
Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, quoted by al-Mizzī
There is nothing objectionable about him.
صالح بن محمد, quoted by al-Mizzī
أبو حاتم الرازي, quoted by al-Mizzī
وإبراهيم بن المنذر أعرف بالحديث إلا أنه خلط في القرآن
Ibrāhīm ibn al-Mundhir knew hadith better than Ibrāhīm ibn Ḥamzah, though he was confused over the question of the Qurʾān.
زكريا بن يحيى الساجي, quoted by al-Mizzī
الحافظ أبو بكر الخطيب, quoted by al-Mizzī
أما المناكير فقل ما توجد في حديثه إلا أن تكون عن المجهولين، ومن ليس بمشهور عند المحدثين، ومع هذا فإن يحيى بن معين وغيره من الحفاظ كانوا يرضونه ويوثقونه

Objectionable reports are seldom found in his hadith unless from unknown transmitters or those not well known to hadith scholars. Nevertheless, Ibn Maʿīn and other hadith masters approved of him and considered him reliable.
أبو عبد الله, quoted by al-Mizzī
Aḥmad asks what it is that has reached him about al-Ḥizāmī.
زكريا بن يحيى الساجي, quoted by al-Mizzī
بلغني أن أحمد بن حنبل كان يتكلم فيه ويذمه
I heard that Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal criticized and reproached him.

t6165.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Muḥammad ibn ʿAmmār ibn Saʿd al-Quraẓ as 'covered' (mastūr), of the fourth generation.

t6709.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records al-Muṭṭalib ibn Ziyād ibn Abī Zuhayr al-Thaqafī, their client, al-Kūfī, as truthful but sometimes erring, of the eighth generation. He died in the year 185.

t7276.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Hirmī ibn ʿAbd Allāh al-Khaṭmī as mastūr, of the second generation; some said he was born in the Prophet's lifetime and sent mursal reports from him; some reversed his name erroneously.

t7500.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Yaḥyā ibn Isḥāq or Ibn Abī Isḥāq al-Anṣārī as trustworthy, of the fourth generation.

t7694.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Yazīd ibn Bābnūs, a Baṣran, as acceptable, of the third generation.

t7935.bio: Ibn Ḥajar lists Abū Isḥāq, client of ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Ḥārith, a Medinan, as acceptable and of the third generation.

t8022.bio: Ibn Ḥajar describes Abū Jaʿfar, teacher of Sawāda ibn Abī al-Jaʿd, as unknown, of the third generation; it is said he is al-Bāqir; cited by al-Nasāʾī.

t8246.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records that Abū al-ʿAjfāʾ al-Sulamī al-Baṣrī is acceptable, of the second generation, and died after the nineties; his name is said to be Haram ibn Nasīb or the reverse.

t828.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Thābit ibn Qays al-Ghifārī, their client, Abū al-Ghaṣn al-Madanī, as truthful but prone to mistakes, of the fifth generation, who died in 168 AH at age one hundred.

t8718.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records her as grandmother of Abū Bakr al-ʿAdawī, of the seventh generation, her condition unknown.

t950.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Hāshimī, Abū ʿAbd Allāh, known as al-Ṣādiq, as truthful, a jurist and imam, of the sixth generation, who died in 148 AH.
as: كان مالك لا يروي عن جعفر بن محمد حتى يضمه إلى آخر من أولئك الرفعاء ثم يجعله بعده
Mālik would transmit from Jaʿfar only when pairing him with one of those highly regarded transmitters, placing Jaʿfar after him.
Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd al-Qaṭṭān, quoted by al-Mizzī
في نفسي منه شيء، قلت: فمجالد؟ قال: مجالد أحب إلي منه
I have reservations about him. When asked about Mujālid, he said he preferred Mujālid to him.
يحيى ابن معين, quoted by al-Mizzī
يحيى ابن معين, quoted by al-Mizzī
Trustworthy, according to ʿAbbās’s version of Ibn Maʿīn’s verdict.
Abū Zurʿah al-Rāzī, quoted by al-Mizzī
Jaʿfar is not to be put on a par with those two, Suhayl and al-ʿAlāʾ.
Abū Ḥātim al-Rāzī, quoted by al-Mizzī
جعفر بن محمد ثقة، لا يسأل عن مثله
Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad is reliable. There is no need to inquire about someone of his standing.
وهو من ثقات الناس كما قال يحيى بن معين
He is among the reliable transmitters, as Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn said.
ما رأيت أحدا أفقه من جعفر بن محمد
I have seen no one more versed in jurisprudence than Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad.
الهياج بن بسطام, quoted by al-Mizzī
كان جعفر بن محمد يطعم حتى لا يبقى لعياله شئ
Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad would give people food until nothing remained for his household.
سعيد بن سلم, quoted by al-Mizzī
This is the supplication of people of noble standing.
مرحبا بالنقي الساحة البرئ من الدغل والخيانة، أخي وابن عمي
Welcome to my brother and cousin, whose conduct is clean and free of deceit and treachery.
أبو بكر بن عياش, quoted by al-Mizzī
سألناه عما يتحدث به من الأحاديث إنني سمعته، قال: لا، ولكنها رواية رويناها عن آبائنا
Abū Bakr ibn ʿAyyāsh says they asked whether Jaʿfar had heard the hadith he related. Jaʿfar answered that it was a tradition they transmitted from their forefathers.
عمرو بن أبو المقدام, quoted by al-Mizzī
كنت إذا نظرت إلي جعفر بن محمد علمت أنه من سلالة النبيين
When I looked at Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad I knew he was descended from the prophets.
Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd al-Qaṭṭān, quoted by al-Mizzī
Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd al-Qaṭṭān, quoted by al-Mizzī
إن كان يحفظ فحديث أبيه المسند يعني حديث جابر في الحج
If he retained a report well, it was his father’s report with a complete chain, Jābir’s account of the pilgrimage.
إن بني جعفر بن محمد الصادق يلحد في سلطاني
Al-Manṣūr accused Jaʿfar of undermining his rule.
